status.description: Find or open a signed-in App Store Connect tab. Read-only: never mutates app data.

inventory.description: GET /iris/v1/apps with versions, plus the active (filter[removed]=false) and removed (filter[removed]=true) name lists. Read-only.

appState.description: One app's availability (territory count + availableInNewTerritories), review submissions, versions, in-app purchase count, beta groups, builds. Read-only.

id.description: App Store Connect app id, e.g. "1671424812"

returns.description: {availableCount, availableInNewTerritories, reviewSubmissions, versions, inAppPurchaseCount, betaGroups, builds} or {stop:"not-signed-in"}

takeOffSale.description: WRITE. PATCH every available territoryAvailabilities/<id> to available:false, 10 at a time. Returns a status-code histogram, not per-territory detail.

clearFutureTerritories.description: WRITE, UI-only step. The API refuses to change availableInNewTerritories directly, so this navigates the tab to the pricing page and drives Manage -> Manage Availability -> uncheck "automatically available in all future..." -> Next -> Confirm, then reads the flag back.

removeApp.description: WRITE, destructive but restorable from Removed Apps. Refuses unless the app's current name equals expectName exactly, then PATCHes removed:true and polls filter[removed]=true for up to 30s (the flag lags about 20s). On failure returns the server's errors[].code and detail verbatim.

expectName.description: Must equal the app's current name exactly, or the call refuses without issuing the PATCH.

returns.description: {refused:reason,...} on a guard failure; {removed:false,status,errors} on a rejected PATCH; {removed:true,confirmed} on success

agreements.description: Read the Business page for agreement rows and tax-form rows. Read-only.
